supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: minimal extension beyond the outer eye corners

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: marked contrast with a significantly lighter muzzle region relative to darker periocular and cheek zones

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thin lower lip with a minor structural droop

pinna_silhouette.outer_helix_geometry: rounded (left ear apex visible; right ear obscured by deformity)
pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: massive bulbous swelling or growth on the right pinna (viewer's left) distorting original helix shape

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: large bulbous growth on the right ear; white chin hair (beard) providing high contrast against dark facial skin
